card.name: Overdosage section headings and openings
card.fires_on: The word OVERDOSAGE (especially its last piece, AGE) in the heading of a label's overdosage section, and the first few words right after it.

modes.label: End of OVERDOSAGE heading
modes.description: The final piece of the split heading OVERDOSAGE, often after a section number like 10.
modes.example: 10. OVERDOS<<AGE>> In the event of overdosage,

modes.label: Opening words of overdose text
modes.description: Linking words in the first sentence of an overdosage section.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE The following is based on the little information available<< concerning>> overdosage with meclofenamate

modes.label: Manual page heading
modes.description: A heading word in a Linux manual page, outside drug labels.
modes.example: EROFS Read-only file system. CONFORMING<< TO>> SVr4, 4.3
